أم.en: My mother loves me and cares for me.

أب.en: My father helps me and encourages me to learn.

طفل.en: A child grows and learns through play.

ولد.en: A boy is a child who learns and plays.

بنت.en: A girl is a child who learns and plays.

أخ.en: I play with my brother and help him.

أخت.en: I play with my sister and help her.

جد.ar: جَدِّي هُوَ أَبُو أَبِي أَوْ أَبُو أُمِّي.
جد.en: My grandfather is the father of my father or mother.

جدة.ar: جَدَّتِي هِيَ أُمُّ أَبِي أَوْ أُمُّ أُمِّي.
جدة.en: My grandmother is the mother of my father or mother.

عائلة.en: A family is people who love and help each other.

رأس.en: My head holds my eyes, ears, and nose.

شعر.ar: الشَّعْرُ يَنْبُتُ عَلَى الرَّأْسِ وَأُرَتِّبُهُ بِالْمِشْطِ.
شعر.en: Hair grows on the head, and I tidy it with a comb.

وجه.en: My face shows my features and expressions.

عين.en: I see with my eye and keep it safe.

أنف.en: I smell with my nose and breathe through it.

فم.en: I use my mouth to eat and speak.

أذن.en: I hear sounds with my ear.

أسنان.en: I chew food with my teeth and clean them.

لسان.ar: أَتَذَوَّقُ الطَّعَامَ بِلِسَانِي وَيُسَاعِدُنِي عَلَى الْكَلَامِ.
لسان.en: I taste food with my tongue, and it helps me speak.

يد.en: I hold things with my hand and wash it.

إصبع.ar: أُشِيرُ بِإِصْبَعِي وَأُسَاعِدُ يَدِي عَلَى الْإِمْسَاكِ.
إصبع.en: I point with my finger and use it to help hold things.

قدم.en: I stand and walk on my feet.

بطن.ar: بَطْنِي هُوَ الْجُزْءُ بَيْنَ صَدْرِي وَحَوْضِي.
بطن.en: My belly is the part between my chest and pelvis.

قميص.ar: أَلْبَسُ الْقَمِيصَ عَلَى الْجُزْءِ الْعُلْوِيِّ مِنْ جِسْمِي.
قميص.en: I wear a shirt on the upper part of my body.

بنطال.en: I wear pants to cover my legs.

فستان.ar: الْفُسْتَانُ ثَوْبٌ يَجْمَعُ الْجُزْءَ الْعُلْوِيَّ وَالتَّنُّورَةَ.
فستان.en: A dress is clothing with a top and a skirt joined together.

سرير.en: I sleep on a bed to rest.

وسادة.ar: أَضَعُ رَأْسِي عَلَى الْوِسَادَةِ عِنْدَ النَّوْمِ.
وسادة.en: I rest my head on a pillow when I sleep.

بطانية.en: I cover myself with a blanket to stay warm.

لعبة.en: I use a toy to play and learn.

دمية.en: I play with a doll and act out a story with it.

بيت.en: A house is a place where we live and rest.

غرفة.ar: الْغُرْفَةُ جُزْءٌ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ لَهُ اسْتِخْدَامٌ مُحَدَّدٌ.
غرفة.en: A room is part of a house with a particular use.

مطبخ.en: We prepare food in the kitchen.

حمام.en: We use the bathroom for washing and using the toilet.

صالة.en: We sit in the living room and talk together.

مفتاح.en: I use a key to open a lock.

جدار.en: A wall separates rooms and surrounds a house.

سقف.en: A ceiling covers the top of a room.

طبق.en: I put food on a plate to eat it.

شوكة.en: I pick up pieces of food with a fork.

قدر.en: Grown-ups cook food in a pot.

إبريق.ar: أَصُبُّ الْمَاءَ مِنَ الْإِبْرِيقِ فِي الْكُوبِ.
إبريق.en: I pour water from a pitcher into a cup.

زجاجة.en: I keep water in a bottle and close it.

خبز.en: Bread is food made from flour.

أرز.en: We cook rice with water to make it soft.

بيض.en: We cook eggs before eating them.

جبن.en: Cheese is food made from milk.

حليب.ar: نَشْرَبُ الْحَلِيبَ وَنَسْتَخْدِمُهُ فِي بَعْضِ الْأَطْعِمَةِ.
حليب.en: We drink milk and use it in some foods.

عصير.en: We make juice by squeezing fruit.

قطة.ar: الْقِطَّةُ حَيَوَانٌ يَمُوءُ وَيُحِبُّ مُطَارَدَةَ الْأَشْيَاءِ.
قطة.en: A cat is an animal that meows and likes chasing things.

كلب.ar: الْكَلْبُ حَيَوَانٌ يَنْبَحُ وَلَهُ حَاسَّةُ شَمٍّ قَوِيَّةٌ.
كلب.en: A dog barks and has a strong sense of smell.

طائر.en: A bird is an animal with feathers and a beak.

سمكة.ar: السَّمَكَةُ تَعِيشُ فِي الْمَاءِ وَتَسْبَحُ بِزَعَانِفِهَا.
سمكة.en: A fish lives in water and swims with its fins.

بقرة.en: A cow eats grass and gives us milk.

دجاجة.en: A hen is a bird that lays eggs.

نملة.ar: النَّمْلَةُ حَشَرَةٌ صَغِيرَةٌ تَعِيشُ مَعَ نَمْلٍ آخَرَ.
نملة.en: An ant is a small insect that lives with other ants.

نحلة.en: A bee collects nectar from flowers.

فراشة.ar: الْفَرَاشَةُ حَشَرَةٌ لَهَا أَجْنِحَةٌ تَطِيرُ بِهَا.
فراشة.en: A butterfly is an insect with wings it uses to fly.

سيارة.en: A car carries people on roads.

حافلة.ar: تَنْقُلُ الْحَافِلَةُ عَدَدًا مِنَ الرُّكَّابِ مَعًا.
حافلة.en: A bus carries several passengers together.

شاحنة.ar: تَحْمِلُ الشَّاحِنَةُ الْبَضَائِعَ مِنْ مَكَانٍ إِلَى آخَرَ.
شاحنة.en: A truck carries goods from one place to another.

دراجة.en: I move a bicycle with its pedals and wear a helmet.

قطار.en: A train travels on a railway track.

طائرة.ar: تَطِيرُ الطَّائِرَةُ فِي الْجَوِّ لِنَقْلِ النَّاسِ أَوِ الْبَضَائِعِ.
طائرة.en: An airplane flies through the air to carry people or goods.

شمس.en: The sun gives us light and warmth.

شجرة.en: A tree is a plant with a trunk and branches.

زهرة.ar: الزَّهْرَةُ جُزْءٌ مِنَ النَّبَاتِ وَتَجْذِبُ بَعْضَ الْحَشَرَاتِ.
زهرة.en: A flower is part of a plant and attracts some insects.

هاتف.en: I use a phone to communicate with others.

نظارة.ar: تُسَاعِدُ النَّظَّارَةُ بَعْضَ النَّاسِ عَلَى الرُّؤْيَةِ بِوُضُوحٍ.
نظارة.en: Glasses help some people see clearly.

ممحاة.en: I erase pencil marks with an eraser.

مسطرة.ar: أَرْسُمُ خَطًّا مُسْتَقِيمًا بِالْمِسْطَرَةِ وَأَقِيسُ الطُّولَ.
مسطرة.en: I draw a straight line with a ruler and measure length.

طبيب.ar: يَفْحَصُ الطَّبِيبُ الْمَرِيضَ وَيُسَاعِدُهُ عَلَى الْعِلَاجِ.
طبيب.en: A doctor examines a patient and helps with treatment.

شرطي.ar: يُسَاعِدُ الشُّرْطِيُّ عَلَى الْأَمَانِ وَتَنْظِيمِ الْمُرُورِ.
شرطي.en: A police officer helps keep people safe and manages traffic.

سائق.en: A driver operates a vehicle carefully.

نجار.en: A carpenter makes things from wood.

خباز.en: A baker bakes bread in an oven.

طباخ.en: A cook prepares and cooks food.

مزارع.en: A farmer grows plants and cares for them.
